direction: Pokemon-style 2D/2.5D, NOT voxel. Descriptions from the pasted canon manifests, completing the previously truncated Gorokappa entry.

entries.appendages: Oversized, heavy metal cube fists wrapped in glowing white data-streams. Large wind-up key turning slowly on its back.
entries.base: Small, blocky box torso with a round, cog-shaped head.
entries.concept: Small, metallic, childlike machine wrapping its metal fists in digital tape.
entries.material_color: Tarnished brass #b5a642 and steel, with bright, glowing green #00ff00 digital eyes.
entries.name: Gearkid
entries.status: SPEC — described in pasted manifest, not yet a sprite
entries.vfx: Rhythmic, mechanical tick-tock sound and tiny gear-shaped particles when it attacks.

entries.appendages: Heavy, hydraulic-powered arms. Championship belt made of a massive, glowing golden polygon around its waist.
entries.base: Broad-shouldered, inverted-triangle chassis built for grappling.
entries.concept: Larger, two-armed robotic champion with a glowing championship belt.
entries.material_color: Polished chrome #e0e0e0 with aggressive red #cc0000 detailing.
entries.name: Mechapion
entries.status: SPEC — described in pasted manifest, not yet a sprite
entries.vfx: On entering battle, slams fists together, creating a localized shockwave ring and a shower of golden sparks.

entries.appendages: Four incredibly thick, multi-jointed arms ending in heavy grappling claws. Flat, robotic beak face with a glowing, recessed water-dish (kappa bowl) on top of its head.
entries.base: Massive, hunched behemoth. Back covered by a thick, metallic dish-shaped shell.
entries.concept: Massive, 4-armed wrestling cyborg with a mechanical turtle/kappa face and a heavy metallic shell.
entries.material_color: Deep aquatic green #004422 armor plates over a dark, industrial-grey endoskeleton.
entries.name: Gorokappa
entries.status: SPEC — described in pasted manifest, not yet a sprite
entries.vfx: Glowing bowl constantly emits a localized digital waterfall, spilling translucent blue data-pixels over its shoulders.

entries.appendages: Two separate, floating stone spheres acting as fists. No arms connecting them; they hover via magnetic/digital fields.
entries.base: Central, jagged dodecahedron acting as the main face/body.
entries.concept: Floating, jagged rock with two heavy stone fists.
entries.material_color: Rough, unpolished granite #666666 with glowing amber #ffbf00 cracks.
entries.name: Pebblefist
entries.status: SPEC — described in pasted manifest, not yet a sprite. NOTE: this description gives NO HP value — Pebblefist HP is still unconfirmed, 45 remains an assistant guess.
entries.vfx: Floating fists constantly grind against the air, shedding a continuous trickle of grey dust.

entries.appendages: Four distinct, floating boulder-fists rotating around its central mass like moons orbiting a planet.
entries.base: Cluster of interlocking, asymmetrical polygon boulders.
entries.concept: Larger, multi-armed formation of rolling boulders.
entries.material_color: Dark igneous rock #333333 covered in patches of glowing, crystalline data-veins.
entries.name: Cragarm
entries.status: SPEC — described in pasted manifest, not yet a sprite
entries.vfx: Does not walk; central boulders grind and roll over each other like a tumbling avalanche.

entries.appendages: Heavy, column-like legs and a sharp, snapping beak telescoping out from fissures in the boulder.
entries.base: When idle, looks like completely static, massive environment geometry (a giant rock).
entries.concept: Massive, impenetrable boulder that occasionally opens up to reveal a snapping stone turtle head and heavy limbs.
entries.material_color: Weathered, dusty mountain-stone covered in moss.
entries.name: Terrapod
entries.status: SPEC — described in pasted manifest, not yet a sprite
entries.vfx: On transitioning from Boulder Mode to Turtle Mode, violently vents high-pressure dust from its seams, creating a temporary smokescreen.

entries.appendages: Cute, stubby arms and legs. Glowing, translucent cyan visor over its eyes.
entries.base: Smooth, upright bipedal body carrying a perfectly round, dome-shaped sphere shell on its back.
entries.concept: Cute, bipedal turtle with a tiny tactical helmet-like shell. NOTE: this is a THIRD Sproutle concept — earlier manifests had a Flora/Core seedling and a Flora/Chrome roster entry. Roster elements are Flora/Chrome; paste line header says Aqua/Chrome. Do not merge silently.
entries.material_color: Seafoam green #20b2aa skin. Shell matte military-olive #556b2f, looking exactly like a digital combat helmet.
entries.name: Sproutle
entries.status: SPEC — described in pasted manifest, not yet a sprite
entries.vfx: On a defensive move, ducks entirely inside its helmet-shell, projecting a faint, hexagonal energy shield around it.

entries.appendages: Thick, muscular arms ending in sharp, three-fingered claws.
entries.base: Heavy, wide-stanced bipedal turtle. Shell is an oversized, flattened cylinder heavily reinforced with bunker-like ridges.
entries.concept: Warrior-turtle whose shell has grown into a thick island-like bunker.
entries.material_color: Deep ocean blue #003366 skin. Shell reinforced concrete-grey #808080 with small, glowing portholes.
entries.name: Shellguard
entries.status: SPEC — described in pasted manifest, not yet a sprite
entries.vfx: Portholes pulse with red emergency lighting. Leaves deep, heavy footprint decals.

entries.appendages: Six incredibly thick, bug-like segmented legs. Two colossal, biomechanical cannons protruding from the front of its shell, flanking its head.
entries.base: Gargantuan quadruped chassis. Shell is a massive, highly detailed fortress plateau, large enough that the player could theoretically stand on it.
entries.concept: Colossal, bug-like turtle tank. Back is a literal moving island fortress with built-in organic cannons.
entries.material_color: Dark, abyssal armor plating. Fortress shell is a mix of metallic chrome and glowing, biological energy conduits.
entries.name: Dreadtoise
entries.status: SPEC — described in pasted manifest, not yet a sprite
entries.vfx: Cannons constantly vent a shimmering heat-haze. When it fires a Water or Chrome attack, recoil physically pushes its massive body backward, leaving deep gouges in the terrain.

note: Roster numbering. Sproutle line element conflict (paste Aqua/Chrome vs roster Flora/Chrome) is open, see unification-map.
